coverage: Preface and all three sections in both English editions, including named footnote references. Hypothetical moral agents and philosophical concepts are not invented cast members.

entities.name: Christian Wolff
entities.body: The German philosopher whose general practical philosophy Kant distinguishes from his own project.

entities.name: Socrates
entities.body: The ancient Athenian philosopher known for drawing out people’s understanding through questioning.

entities.name: Jesus Christ
entities.body: The central figure of Christianity, here called the Holy One of the Gospels.

entities.name: God
entities.body: The divine being considered in Kant’s discussion of moral perfection and the will.

entities.name: Johann Georg Sulzer
entities.body: The Swiss philosopher who corresponded with Kant about moral education.

entities.name: Juno
entities.body: The Roman goddess invoked in the mythical image of mistaking a cloud for a goddess.

entities.name: Francis Hutcheson
entities.body: The philosopher associated with the moral-sense theory Kant discusses.
